## Goal

The live deployment is real, but the `security_ops` verifier still records it as
a deferral whose reason is `live_render_url_returns_404_measured`. That sentence
was true when t41 wrote it and is false now, and a register that lists a
satisfied obligation as deferred is a defect of the same class as a fabricated
PASS: it makes the register untrustworthy as an inventory of what is genuinely
unverified. This card moves exactly ONE row - `LIVE_DEPLOYMENT_STATE` - out of
the DEFERRED set and into a `VERIFIED_ROW` that carries the measured live
evidence, moves the URL constant that row is built from to the host that
actually answers, regenerates the criteria report from the generator (never by
hand), and moves the two `ops/` prose documents off the 404 premise.

Moving that row necessarily turns tests[187] RED, because that gate pins the
header literal, the row count AND the old row's full text. So this card also
carries a formal gate amendment that **RE-PREMISES** tests[187] - replacing the
5-count pin with a 4-count pin plus a strictly stronger verified-row assertion
whose eight fields must all match - and proves by measured negative controls
that the amended gate still bites.

ac_hash: sha256:`6941e150 c324661c 6f3baf5b 3a73fde9 2b10e3de b41a589e 97ea8d97 4e5340c1`

Six fenced commands, byte-identical to
`evidence.verification_commands.ac1..ac6` in
`docs/state/outputs/t93_definer_groom.json`. The digest is sha256 over the
`JSON.stringify` array of the six FENCED BLOCKS in ac1..ac6 order, each block
taken exactly as it sits between its ```bash fences (the `bash -c '...'` wrapper
INCLUDED) with COMPACT separators and each block CR-stripped and trimmed - the
t58/t62..t92 recipe, so the digest covers the command exactly as it is pasted
rather than a re-derived form. The full 64-hex value is in the handoff JSON and
appears here only as eight spaced groups, because `docs/` IS gitleaks-scanned
and a bare 64-hex literal in a doc is both a scan surface and a copy-paste
shortcut.

Each fence carries the SAME base64-embedded probe (22589 bytes, sha256
`b7d3b6fe4245d1aed7d099c98a07d5378397c89d4c5a2877e9daada1206fdb13`) and differs
only in the mode argument, so a payload edit shows up as one digest change and
the six fences cannot drift apart. The probe materialises into a `mktemp -d`
directory, is passed `"$PWD"` as its root, and fails loudly (never skips) if
python3, mktemp, or the payload is unavailable.

## Constraints (hard)

- `docs/criteria/**` is NEVER hand-edited by any writer. It changes only as
  generator output; ac2's equality leg is the fence that proves it.
- RE-PREMISE, never relax: the amended tests[187] must still fail if a real
  deferral disappears from the register or if the verified row lacks any one of
  its live fields. Measured: `drop_genuine_row` -> rc=1
  (`DEFERRED_ROW count 3 != 4`), `header4_row_stays` -> rc=1
  (`DEFERRED_ROW count 5 != 4`), `verified_missing_db` /
  `verified_missing_fallback` / `verified_wrong_host` / `verified_on_pass_line`
  -> rc=1 each. If the amended leg cannot bite, the card FAILS.
- The verified row is a TOKEN, never a check: it must not end ` PASS` and must
  not raise the 29 PASS rows or the 28 `ALL_CHECKS_PASS` footer. That single
  shape decision is what keeps `docs_verification.md` byte-identical and this
  card to one criteria report.
